chapter: Hollywood, Ken Murray and the Penguin years
title: The Flame in Duluth and Farmingdale
summary: His brother dies as he opens in Duluth in December 1946, then a fine Long Island club.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: What I was trying to think of, we had this one copied already so there's no problem. How much further---after this, this is out at the Flame, Duluth; right?
That wasn't the time when I was on my way to Hollywood.
No, this was later.
This was way later.
This is '48, maybe '49.

I can tell you exactly. That was taken in almost '47, because my brother died just as I was getting ready to go work. It was in December of '46. This was more likely January of '47, but I opened December of '46.
This is in Duluth?
The Flame Show Bar?
Right. It was a big club though.
I know, because they're still wearing the tuxedos, which is full dress. What I'm trying to do now is figure out--go from '46-'47; where do you go from here? How long did this job last?
That job lasted about three or four months.
Then where did you go from there?
We came back to New York and went out to Farmingdale.
What was out there?
It was one of the finest
clubs, they didn't want us to come in. It was a very fine club but they never had a colored band in there before. I don't remember the name of that club even, but it was a fine club.
I can find out. Was this with the same group of guys?
Yeah.
How long did that job last?
That job lasted about four months.
You did some business out there?
A wonderful business.
This would have been around the time you were recording Hasty Man?
He recorded it with me.
Is he from New York?
He's from New York.
Yeah.
Frank Cahill.
You made quite a few sides for Penguin?
Right. Blue Memories, I've Been a Fool, I'm a Fool About Mama, Could This Be Love, Abrazamae (phonetic spelling).
That's not your tune?
No.
That sounds like a great theme song for you though. In Farmingdale, Dresnon is getting these bookings; right?
Right.
